FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS, SECTOR 25,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014
Advertisement for Project Assistant
Applications are invited along with the complete bio-data and attested copies of certificates showing
qualifications and experience for one post of Project Assistant in the research project entitled
“Development of Peptide mediated antisense oligonucleotide (PMAsO) based next
generation therapeutics for priority pathogens” by DHR, Government of India granted to Dr.
Ravi Pratap Barnwal (PI) and Dr. Gurpal Singh and Prof. Ashwani Koul (coPIs). Intial appointment is
for one year, extended up to 3 years based on the performance. Applications should reach the
undersigned by 22/08/2025 either by post or email at barnwal@pu.ac.in
Eligibility: M.Sc. in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Chemistry/allied subjects
with minimum 55% marks. “Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/PU PhD (Biophysics)/ other national
entrance test conducted by Government of India will be preferred.”
Age: 30 years (maximum)
Desirable: Experience with peptide, amtimicrobial work and nanotechnology
Emoluments: Rs. 26,000/-p.m. (consolidated) for three years as per DHR/ICMR or Panjab University
guidelines.
Yours sincerely
/SD
Ravi Pratap Barnwal, Ph.D.
Department of Biophysics, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with project.
Candidates should mention their email address and phone number in the bio data.
